initiative.description:
## 1. Executive summary

*(Regenerated at enrichment: 27 findings applied to the body below.)*

Mastercard brand implementation mandate **MCS-2026-R3** is binding on JPMC Merchant Services with full compliance required by **2026-09-30**. Enrichment has since checked v1's current-state claims against the Merchant Routing Service code and recorded the derived system impacts in §16.

Two findings reshape the plan. The routing KB's account of brand identification does not match the code — there is no PAN/BIN-range lookup in this repo — so §2 is corrected with code provenance. And the ISO 8583 impl

stories.summary: Preserve DE 48.66 Token Requestor ID through encode/decode
acceptance_criteria: R1.2 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/messaging/field_codec.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: DE 48.66 TRID must survive encode/decode; the per-field codec enforces preservation

stories.summary: Populate DE 48.77 for wallet-originated transactions
acceptance_criteria: R1.3 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/messaging/field_codec.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: DE 48.77 must be populated for wallet-originated transactions — a second encode obligation on the same codec, distinct from R2.2's format definition

stories.summary: Encode DE 48.77 digital wallet indicator
acceptance_criteria: R2.2 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/messaging/field_codec.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: DE 48.77 wallet indicator needs an encode path in the per-field codec

stories.summary: Encode DE 48.78 token assurance level and trigger RC 55 below 10
acceptance_criteria: R2.3 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/messaging/field_codec.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: DE 48.78 token assurance needs encode/decode plus the <10 RC 55 trigger

stories.summary: Provide a DE 48.79 device type encode path (not enabled this release)
acceptance_criteria: R2.4 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/messaging/field_codec.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: DE 48.79 device type is optional and the operator ruled it out of this release (§10), but the codec is where it would land if reinstated

stories.summary: Bound Banknet authorization at 4000ms with secondary-endpoint attempt
acceptance_criteria: R4.1 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/routing/retry.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: the 4000ms bound and secondary-endpoint attempt land on bounded retry

stories.summary: Forward to STIP on secondary endpoint timeout
acceptance_criteria: R4.3 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/routing/dispatch.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: STIP forwarding on secondary timeout is a dispatch decision

stories.summary: Write reason code T to the audit record on every fallback attempt
acceptance_criteria: R4.2 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/routing/retry.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: reason code T must be written to the transaction audit record on every fallback attempt

stories.summary: Re-map Response Code 55 in the error code table
acceptance_criteria: R5.1 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/routing/error_codes.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: RC 55 re-mapping lands on the error code table and its text

stories.summary: Update merchant-facing decline text for RC 55 on token transactions
acceptance_criteria: R5.2 holds against the changed code.
The change is confined to src/routing/fallback.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: merchant-facing decline text on the fallback path

stories.summary: Recognise token BIN range 520000-529999 at decline time

The change is confined to src/routing/brand_registry.c and its callers.
Existing Mastercard, Visa and Discover dispatch is unaffected.
stories.description: token BIN range 520000-529999 must be recognisable at decline time to distinguish RC 55 semantics

stories.summary: Populate DE 48.78 before interchange rate assessment

The change is confined to src/routing/brand_registry.c and its callers.

stories.summary: Implement Regulation II unaffiliated-network selection

The change is confined to src/routing/route_table.c and its callers.

stories.summary: Build the MDES token coverage metrics emitter
acceptance_criteria: A new component exists that satisfies R8 R8.3.
Its output is verifiable end to end in UAT before Gate C2 submission.
No existing behaviour regresses.
stories.description: R8.3 requires MDES token coverage reporting (TRID population, DE 48.77 coverage). No reporting or metrics emitter exists anywhere in the map — genuinely new build.

stories.summary: Build the Regulation II quarterly compliance report
acceptance_criteria: A new component exists that satisfies R8 R8.2.
Its output is verifiable end to end in UAT before Gate C2 submission.
No existing behaviour regresses.
stories.description: R8.2 requires a Regulation II quarterly compliance report. No reporting path exists anywhere in the map — same gap class as F-330.

stories.summary: Deliver F-331
acceptance_criteria: A new component exists that satisfies R9 R9.2.
Its output is verifiable end to end in UAT before Gate C2 submission.
No existing behaviour regresses.
stories.description: R9.2 requires 1,000 traces submitted in JSONL to the Mastercard Testing API. No trace-capture or submission path exists in the repo.

stories.summary: Deliver F-361
acceptance_criteria: A new component exists that satisfies R9 R9.1.
Its output is verifiable end to end in UAT before Gate C2 submission.
No existing behaviour regresses.
stories.description: R9.1 requires running the MTS v8.4 suite against a UAT environment. Test-harness work; nothing in this repo participates.

stories.summary: Sustain C3 production monitoring thresholds
acceptance_criteria: A new component exists that satisfies R9 R9.3.
Its output is verifiable end to end in UAT before Gate C2 submission.
No existing behaviour regresses.
stories.description: R9.3 requires sustaining C3 production monitoring thresholds. Depends on the metrics emitter F-330 identified as absent.
